paper_title: New axion and hidden photon constraints from a solar data global fit
notes: Solar global fit (helioseismology + neutrino fluxes) bound. Axion-photon coupling limit g_agamma < 4.1e-10 GeV^-1 at 3-sigma CL (g10 < 4.1), valid as a mass-independent (flat) ALP bound for m_a below ~eV where Primakoff production is efficient (see Fig. 9 'Sun (global)' line). Encoded as horizontal line. NOTE: the paper ALSO derives a hidden-photon (DarkPhoton) constraint chi*m < 1.8e-12 eV valid over 3e-5 eV to 8 eV, which is the more novel result; if DarkPhoton is desired, chi = 1.8e-12/m[eV]. Confidence reduced because the paper constrains two coupling types.
